notes: Hamster Road Trip voting contract on Sepolia. RoadTripVotes(uint256 epochSeconds, uint256 destinationCount) is deployed with epochSeconds = 86400 (24-hour epochs, aligned to UTC days: epoch = block.timestamp / 86400) and destinationCount = 64 (valid destination ids 0 to 63). Each wallet votes once per epoch via vote(destinationId); after an epoch ends anyone may call finalize(epoch), which records the destination with the most votes (ties to the lowest id) and appends it to the route queue once. Views: currentEpoch, votesFor, winnerOf, hasVoted, leaderOf, routeLength, routeAt, route. Per the approved brief the contract has no owner, admin, upgrade path, token or payments, so no $owner argument exists; both constructor values are immutable and there are no post-launch settings. The constructor is nonpayable, reads no other contract and no block data. This launch deploys only this contract; the website reads its deployed address and docs/abi/RoadTripVotes.json.
